cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm standing up with you. Give away your prize seat if you're really on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stood to take my coat off. I'm sitting back down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, preparing to move. The standing section can see us supporting the team together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give away your seat first. I'll follow you to the standing section.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine's on the aisle. Keep it empty for me in case supporting the team takes too long.
